publicationStatus: Historical benchmark research only; calibrated 2027 probability model unavailable

gates.name: Historical Assembly targets
gates.evidence: Independent winning-party targets cover all sixty seats in 2012, 2017 and 2022. The original sixty-seat 2007 elected-member register separately supplies an earlier predictor. Full candidate-vote coverage and territorial certification remain separate questions.

gates.name: Reproducible reference rules
gates.evidence: Three retrospective Assembly transitions (2007→2012, 2012→2017, 2017→2022), separate frozen protocols, same-cohort comparisons and all seat errors. The statewide tie policy differs across protocols and remains explicit. Existing reports are unchanged.

gates.name: Historical Parliamentary context comparison
gates.evidence: Separate event-prior context rule evaluated on 60-seat / 58-seat common cohorts, with all errors, abstentions and paired comparisons. Only two retrospective windows; original publication-version availability unverified. 2014 combined rows have five selected scan comparisons; 2019 Henglep remains withheld.

gates.name: Dated current membership
gates.evidence: Sixty directory entries captured on 20 October; individual effective dates remain unavailable. Bounded 22 October source check confirms the party-position page prints 11 September 2025 while its site footer prints 5 October 2026. Neither capture nor footer certifies current affiliations.

gates.name: 2027 candidate and alliance inputs
gates.evidence: No complete verified, dated 2027 nomination or alliance set is indexed. Three official index pages were checked on 22 October; historical candidate/nomination links are not a 2027 slate. This bounded search does not prove no announcements exist elsewhere.

gates.name: Representative opinion inputs
gates.evidence: No sufficiently reviewed representative constituency-level opinion dataset is included.

gates.name: Additional independent evaluation windows
gates.evidence: Three distinct Assembly transitions; five evaluation views because the two Parliamentary-context comparisons reuse 2017/2022 targets. These are not five independent election windows. Correlated seats and retrospective protocol writing do not establish calibration.

gates.name: Probability estimation and calibration
gates.evidence: No fitted 2027 probability model, held-out calibration or uncertainty validation is published. Deterministic benchmark hit rates are not win probabilities.

gates.name: Prospective evaluation record
gates.evidence: These rules were replayed after outcomes were known. They were not pre-registered election predictions.
